description: The bar chart titled "Recall@10" illustrates the performance of different methods in terms of recall at 10. The vertical axis represents recall values ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, while the horizontal axis lists four methods: "Ours," "critiquing," "scoring," and "ranking." The "Ours" method, represented by an orange bar, has the highest recall value, approximately 0.35. The "critiquing" method, shown in blue, has a recall value of about 0.3. The "scoring" method has a significantly lower recall value, around 0.15, and the "ranking" method has a recall value of approximately 0.2. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
